7.2.12 Effect: E_PRE_NOCOM
[SWS_CanSM_00431] Upstream requirements: SRS_Can_01142, SRS_Can_01145
⌈The effect E_PRE_NOCOM of the CanSM_BSM state machine shall call for the corresponding CAN network the API BswM_CanSM_CurrentState (ref. to
[SWS_CanSM_91002]) with the parameters Network := CanSMComMNetworkHandleRef and CurrentState := CANSM_BSWM_NO_COMMUNICATION.⌋
